resolved_findings: Cold mayonnaise rice bowls now have coherent titles and cold dressing.
Raw turkey specifies breast mince; bacon is trimmed/weighed raw; dried egg noodles carry egg/gluten.
Eggs are beaten once; cooked turkey is not cooled/reheated again; measured yoghurt toastie dip stays cold.
Oats have measured liquid,6-hour refrigerated rest, fruit preparation,toppings and lidded equipment.
Potato preparation,heat sources,strainers and meat thermometers are listed; measured flavour ingredients have a method step.
Slow dishes have truthful timing/classification including rest.
